outputs.explanation: Panel A shows macroscopic (ex vivo) bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD, and the individual biological replicate data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C consists of an H&E micrograph, an ICG fluorescence image, an RNAscope micrograph, and spatial expression heatmaps (Cd68, Spp1) overlaid on tissue sections. These are micrographs/spatial heatmaps, not bar/mean plots requiring individual data points.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment line plots (running enrichment score curves). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from a Seurat differential expression (Wilcoxon rank-sum) comparison between low pH and high pH regions, with associated p-values shown. Each bar represents a single computed statistic (not a mean across biological replicates), so individual replicate data points are not applicable here.
Panel F shows representative ICG fluorescence images and IHC-stained tissue images (photographs/micrographs), not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
